quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #14
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: Drivers do not have to yield to pedestrians in a crosswalk.
questions.explanation: Drivers must stop and yield to pedestrians in marked crosswalks. Drivers must also yield to pedestrians in unmarked crosswalks on their side of the road when there are no traffic signals.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the road ahead is divided. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: A bicyclist who breaks traffic laws:

options.text: Is allowed to break traffic laws.
Will always get a warning from police.
Will have their bicycle taken away.

questions.explanation: Bicyclists have the same rights, duties, and responsibilities as car drivers. Both can be ticketed for breaking traffic laws.

questions.question: At a railroad crossing with more than one track, you should:

options.text: Wait until you can clearly see all tracks before going.
Stop on the first track and watch for another train.
Go as soon as the train passes.
Go when one track is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until you can clearly see all tracks before going.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing with more than one track, do not move when one train passes. Wait until you can see all tracks clearly before crossing. Even with one track, check again for another train after one passes.

questions.question: You can pass another vehicle if the line between your lane and the passing lane is a ____ line.
questions.explanation: White lines separate lanes going the same direction. You can cross broken white lines to pass if the other lane is clear.

questions.question: To prevent hydroplaning, you should:

options.text: Keep your tires in good condition.
Fill your tires to the correct air pressure.

questions.explanation: To prevent hydroplaning, keep your tire tread in good condition and inflate them to the correct pressure. Slow down when driving in rain. Hydroplaning happens most often at high speeds.

questions.question: If you find a defect that could affect safe driving, you should:

options.text: Fix it as soon as possible.
Fix it when you have money.

questions.correctAnswerText: Fix it as soon as possible.
questions.explanation: Any defect that could affect safe driving must be fixed as soon as possible. Fix it before driving the vehicle.

questions.question: Which of the following must you obey first?
questions.explanation: Orders from a traffic officer come before signs, signals, and road markings. Police officers, fire police, road workers, and school crossing guards can direct traffic.

questions.question: To make sure your health does not cause unsafe driving, you should:

options.text: Stay physically fit and get regular checkups.
Know how medicine affects your driving.
Drive only within your physical limits.

questions.explanation: Your health matters for safe driving. Know your physical limits and only drive if it is safe.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people crossing. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What happens when you take drugs with alcohol?

options.text: It increases the risk of a crash.
It is no more dangerous than alcohol alone.
It reduces the effect of alcohol on your driving.
It has no effect on your driving ability.

questions.correctAnswerText: It increases the risk of a crash.
questions.explanation: Drugs can affect your brain and impair your driving. This includes illegal drugs, prescription drugs, and over-the-counter medicines. Mixing drugs with alcohol makes driving much more dangerous.

questions.question: Where are you not allowed to park?

options.text: On a crosswalk or in a marked bicycle lane.
Within 12 inches of the right side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: On a crosswalk or in a marked bicycle lane.
questions.explanation: You cannot park on a crosswalk or in a marked bicycle lane. When parking on the street, you must be within 12 inches of the edge of the road.

questions.question: What does NOT affect how far a vehicle needs to stop?

options.text: The condition of your vehicle's brakes.
The condition and type of your vehicle's tires.

questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on your reaction time, weather, visibility, vehicle weight, brake condition, tire condition and type, road conditions, and speed. The time of day does not affect stopping distance.

questions.question: If you drink alcohol socially, what is the safest way to get home?

options.text: Get a ride from a friend who has not been drinking.
Take a cold shower before driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get a ride from a friend who has not been drinking.
questions.explanation: The best way to stay safe is to arrange a ride with a sober friend. Coffee and cold showers do not reduce alcohol in your body. It takes about one hour for your body to eliminate one drink.

questions.question: What causes many crashes?

options.text: Drivers going too fast for the conditions.
Drivers checking mirrors and blind spots.
Drivers keeping a four-second following distance.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers going too fast for the conditions.
questions.explanation: Many crashes happen because drivers go too fast for the conditions. Always drive within the speed limit and slow down when conditions are not ideal.

questions.question: What is an octagonal sign?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs are always stop signs. Come to a complete stop when you see a red octagonal sign.

questions.question: What should you do if your vehicle skids?

options.text: Turn your steering wheel toward oncoming traffic.
Turn your steering wheel in the direction of the skid.
Let go of the steering wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your steering wheel in the direction of the skid.
questions.explanation: If your vehicle skids, stay calm and steer in the direction the back of your vehicle is sliding.

questions.question: When can you safely pass on a two-lane road with traffic in both directions?

options.text: You can clearly see the road ahead.
You can return to your lane before meeting oncoming traffic.
Your vehicle is fast enough to pass.

questions.explanation: Safe passing requires all three conditions: clear visibility ahead, enough space to return to your lane before oncoming traffic, and a vehicle capable of passing speed. Never pass where it is illegal or unsafe.

questions.question: When changing lanes to the left, where should you look to check your blind spot?
questions.explanation: Look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move to check your blind spot.

questions.question: What color lines divide lanes moving in the same direction?
questions.explanation: White lines separate lanes moving in the same direction. Solid white lines cannot be crossed. Broken white lines can be crossed to pass. Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions.

questions.question: What affects how alcohol impacts your body?

options.text: The amount of food in your stomach
How much time passes between drinks

questions.explanation: Your blood alcohol level depends on how much you drink, how much time passes between drinks, and your weight. Eating before or while drinking slows alcohol absorption, but it cannot stop intoxication if you drink too much.

questions.question: When a traffic light turns green, you should:

options.text: Wait until another driver waves you on.

questions.explanation: A green light means you can go through the intersection. However, you must first let any traffic and pedestrians in the intersection clear the way.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and check that the way is clear before moving forward.

questions.question: The space you need to cross traffic depends on:

options.text: Road conditions, weather, and oncoming traffic

questions.correctAnswerText: Road conditions, weather, and oncoming traffic
questions.explanation: The space you need to cross traffic depends on road conditions, weather, and oncoming traffic.

questions.question: At a four-way stop, drivers must let anyone who arrived before them go first.
questions.explanation: At a four-way stop, you must let drivers who arrived before you go first. Wait your turn to enter the intersection.
